prompt:

Header text verbatim: "sjutton". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "seventeen".
Scene: Top-down compartment box containing exactly seventeen distinct buttons, grouped in rows of five, five, five and two with empty spacing, large numeral 17, no decorative button shapes elsewhere.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "sjutton = seventeen; 17 is ten plus seven.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Det finns sjutton knappar i lådan.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
styleReference: Established card style described in the prompt; no image supplied.
